desc:
Update :
- Added secret badges.
- Added a new gamepass that allows you to teleport between levels.

WARNING : The levels will automatically reset if no boxes are moved for a certain amount of time, so make sure you don't leave the boxes unmoved for too long if you don't want to redo everything from the beginning.

This game was originally just some game I made for fun in a few hours many years ago, back when I barely knew anything about how to use Roblox Studio. Thats why it has so many dislikes. When I uploaded the game for the first time, I never thought it would blow up and I still don't understand why it did. After learning how to script, I tried making the game a little bit better by adding reset buttons, auto reset and stuff like that. Even though the ratio is bad, I'm still getting a few compliments on my game. Some people say it feels nostalgic. Thanks for playing ! :)
